segments.text: Hey — this is PR Guard. It's a security-aware code review agent on TrueForge.
You paste a pull request link. The agent reads the diff over MCP, runs tests in a sandbox, and walks a security checklist.
We're using a fixture repo with intentional bugs on purpose. Watch it pull the diff, clone the repo, and run npm test.
Two subagents run in parallel here — one for tests, one for security — so the main agent doesn't drown in output.
Tests pass. But security still catches real problems — SQL injection, missing auth, and a hardcoded API key.
It drafts one review comment. Severity, file, line, impact, and a fix. Comment only — never approve or request changes.
Now the important part. Posting a public review is irreversible. TrueForge stops and asks for approval — Allow or Deny.
That's the licence to act. We click Allow.
And the review shows up on the real pull request — test results plus every finding, with file and line.
That's PR Guard — MCP, sandbox, skills, subagents, approval gate, sessions. All on TrueForge.
